knowledge:
- key_parameters: algorithm=choice of 1) a weighted-sum probability matrix, 2) log-probabilities, or 3) weighted by relative entropy to judge motif disruptiveness ;; genome=any of the 32 curated species (109 versions) available within Bioconductor
- alternatives: None mentioned
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing the impact of novel or previously described single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) on transcription factor binding sites across curated genomes.
- pitfalls: None mentioned in the provided documentation.

workflows.name: predict_motif_disruption
workflows.intent: Predict the disruptiveness of single nucleotide polymorphisms on transcription factor binding sites.
input: variants.vcf (user-provided novel or public database SNPs)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the target genome and SNP data ;; 2. Select transcription factor motifs from public sources ;; 3. Run the disruptiveness prediction using one of the three available algorithms (weighted-sum, log-probabilities, or relative entropy) ;; 4. Compare the alleles to judge information gain or loss
